We spent a year with 100+ content creators building the shared language of cinema for AI. A structured video specification grounded by 200+ visual primitives across subjects, scenes, motion, spatial framing, and camera dynamics. Critique-based Human-AI oversight (CHAI) : AI drafts fluent captions, humans critique visual errors — each doing what they’re best at. Post-training on CHAI triplets lets our 8B Qwen3-VL surpass GPT-5 and Gemini-3.1-Pro on captioning, reward modeling, and critique generation.
